omopColumns.name: nhs_number

dataSource.name: patient_identifier_value
dataSource.description: Patient NHS number, used to join existing OMOP Person records.

omopColumns.query:
select
    patient_identifier_value,
    clinical_date,
    clinical_datetime,
    clinical_code,
    case when length(trim(clinical_code)) >= 3 then upper(trim(clinical_code)) end as concept_code
from ##duckdb_source##
where upper(trim(clinical_code_system)) in ('ICD-10', 'ICD10')
order by source_record_id, warehouse_identifier

omopColumns.name: procedure_source_concept_id
omopColumns.operation_description: Resolve ICD10 codes to standard or non standard OMOP concepts. If code cannot be mapped, map using the parent code.

dataSource.name: concept_code
dataSource.description: Uppercase, trimmed ICD10 code. Codes shorter than three characters are passed as null to the existing resolver, yielding unknown concept 0 rather than throwing. Only Procedure-domain targets are retained.
